explanation: A title for Jesus Christ symbolizing his sacrifice for humanity's sins, often associated with the Passover lamb from the Old Testament.
People who are rescued from sin and death through faith in Jesus Christ's sacrifice and grace.
A number that in a biblical context often represents a large, complete multitude or a great number of people.
One of the most important expressions of gratitude and worship toward God, here used regarding the heavenly congregation.
A division that in Revelation often refers to a quarter of the earth or of humanity affected by judgment.
Pictures or statues that are worshipped, connecting with idolatry and turning away from the true God.
A precious metal symbolizing purity, value, and God's glory in heaven.
People or things dedicated to God, cleansed from sin and devoted to his service.
The time when God will judge the world for injustice and reward the righteous.
